result.summary: This PR adds nine new unit tests to addrman_tests.cpp covering AddrMan::Add edge cases: empty/rejected batches, mixed batches, duplicates, unroutable rejection, timestamp penalty clamping, one-hour and 24-hour update boundaries, source-bucket stability, tried-table preservation, and service flag merging. It is purely additive test code with no production behavior changes.
result.problem: AddrMan::Add has several subtle behaviors (timestamp update boundaries, penalty clamping, bucket stability, service merging) that were apparently under-tested, making regressions in this logic harder to catch during review or refactors.

result.card: This PR adds nine unit tests to addrman_tests.cpp covering AddrMan::Add edge cases: empty/rejected batches, duplicates, timestamp update boundaries, penalty clamping, source-bucket stability, tried-table preservation, and service flag merging, with no production code changes.
